```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`db2pq` stores files as `<DATA_DIR>/<schema>/<table>.parquet`. The file utility
helpers inspect embedded `last_modified` metadata and manage archived copies.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
pq_last_modified(schema = "crsp")
pq_archive("dsi", "crsp")
pq_restore("dsi_20240101T120000Z", "crsp")
pq_remove("dsi_20240101T120000Z", "crsp", archive = TRUE)
```
